name: Antigravity Lite GUI
postCreateCommand: sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://us-central1-apt.pkg.dev/doc/repo-signing-key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/antigravity.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/antigravity.gpg] https://us-central1-apt.pkg.dev/projects/antigravity-auto-updater-dev/ antigravity-debian main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/antigravity.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y antigravity firefox-esr
